mapper.sql: id, project_name, location, contractor, supervisor, start_date, end_date, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM construction_project
deleted = 0
AND status = #{status}
AND (project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{area}, '%') OR location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{area}, '%') OR contractor LIKE CONCAT('%', #{area}, '%'))
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, project_name, location, contractor, supervisor, start_date, end_date, status, ST_AsText(geom) AS geom_wkt, ST_X(geom) AS longitude, ST_Y(geom) AS latitude, created_at, updated_at FROM construction_project WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO construction_project (id, project_name, location, contractor, supervisor, start_date, end_date, status, geom, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectName}, #{location}, #{contractor}, #{supervisor}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status},
ST_GeomFromText(#{geomWkt}, 4326), NULL,
#{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, 0)
mapper.select: WITH anchor AS ( SELECT geom AS g FROM construction_project WHERE id = #{projectId} AND deleted = 0 AND geom IS NOT NULL ) SELECT pm.id, pm.pipe_code, pm.pipe_name, pm.pipe_type, pm.status, ST_Distance(pm.geom::geography, anchor.g::geography) AS distance_meters FROM pipe_main pm, anchor WHERE pm.deleted = 0 AND anchor.g IS NOT NULL AND pm.geom && ST_Buffer(anchor.g::geography, #{radiusMeters})::geometry AND ST_DWithin(pm.geom::geography, anchor.g::geography, #{radiusMeters}) ORDER BY distance_meters LIMIT #{limit}
